name: Open-source licence inventory for counsel
summary: Before a release ships or an acquirer asks, counsel and the engineering lead get every open-source package listed with its licence as found, the file and line where it was read, and the duties your own policy attaches to it. A missing, custom or conflicting licence is marked needs review, never cleared.

sources.contribution: The ideas of fixing the delivery way before listing duties, comparing the licence a package declares with what its own files say (file headers included), never counting an unclear licence as unconditional, watching for a choice of licences and a text from another version, using the company's own policy as the authority, and passing contested licence readings to a lawyer.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's inventory method: the policy's own categories and words only, a quoted line with file and line for every licence found, fixed review reasons, a row-for-row count against the list, checks on the policy before use, and a draft addressed to counsel that approves nothing.
